cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Half an hour helping you move buys two hours painting my shed on Saturday. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Saturday's my only lie-in. Can I come after lunch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Afternoon painting costs me cricket. Three hours, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hire a painter. But I need the sofa carried up three flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then two painter-hours covers loading; the stairs cost a third. Cricket's free again.

mechanism: A manages a moving-favor bargain by pricing timing and stair effort while accepting B preferred payment form to preserve agreement.
confusable: Unlike payment in money alone, every burden changes the time or service owed; confident authority must adapt to B feasible arrangement.
comparison: Scheduling cricket and hired painting differ from reducing work by soaking a pan.
seedUse: Use D46-b moving/painting/lie-in/cricket/stairs with S02-b changing method to retain cooperation.
